required_pytest_nodes.expected: A selected recovered task-family proposition yields bounded evidence, state, event and verified receipt lineage plus the exact prior projection digest passed to later cognition. reconstructed_at must be a timezone-aware ISO timestamp. An optional cognition tick must be a nonnegative integer and is validated before any projection attempt. Evidence bindings must have valid immutable identities and belong to the selected proposition. Trace evidence rows expose both relation and reliability posture (the signals used to classify support and contradiction), freshness, dependency kind, withdrawal state, and current activity. Each trace v2 event exposes added binding IDs, removed binding IDs, and the active binding IDs reconstructed after that generation; the active set must hash to the successor state's evidence-set digest, and the event must bind to that state's generation, predecessor, and last-update-event ID. State rows expose those links with support and contradiction binding references, and those references must match active bindings' relation or reliability posture at each generation; freshness and unresolved dependency must also agree with the active evidence. The trace independently validates state and event identities, allowed stance and reason values, false-authority postures, contiguous state generations, predecessor links, and one-to-one event/state coverage. Transaction, receipt, and prior-projection verification run without repair; recoverable but unpublished records or receipts leave the trace unresolved instead of changing custody during inspection. A resulting prior projection must contain the traced proposition and is omitted if that generation is not prior to the requested cognition tick. Owner collection and receipt inventories are captured before reconstruction and compared after serialization; any concurrent append invalidates the trace. The replayed final active evidence set and latest state digest must agree with the owner's current membership and state snapshot.

non_claims: a mutation receipt proves a hypothesis is true
external causal attribution or independent model improvement
